title: herdr-parallel-worktree config
description: Lives at DATA_DIR/config.json as defined in SKILL.md's Configuration section (the same place in the user's home regardless of install method). Values differ per person, so it is never kept in the repository. Every key is optional and falls back to its default; the first run writes a file with the defaults.

workerArgs.description: Arguments for the worker claude, passed as-is after `herdr agent start ... --`. An empty array uses each worker's settings default permission mode.

hooks.description: Whether the routing hooks act. Absent means on. See SKILL.md Hooks.
